_status: v4 - owner accepted the defaults ('go, use the defaults') after four review rounds. Still traced by eye from the imagery, so positions are +/- a few metres. Input for the carved terrain: project/scripts/water_data.gd is generated from this file by tools/build_water_data.py.
_crs: scene meters, +X east, +Z south, origin at the parcel centroid (D-6)
_how_to_review: python3 tools/water_overlay.py  (draws this file over the imagery with numbered vertices); correct by vertex id, e.g. 'D7 -> (251, 12)', then python3 tools/build_water_data.py
_units: dimensions are the owner's figures converted from feet, midpoint of the stated range
_v5_changes: pond enlarged (D-153): the rim now sits just inside the tree line in the aerial imagery all round (west lobe, south bank, east tip) and 6-8 m out on the open meadow to the north of the east half; the west tip stays at x~-54 so the track's inner fence still stands on level ground
_v4_changes: south run re-routed after checking the scene fences: the fence line is at z~67 (not 63), so east of x~140 the ditch runs on the bare brown strip just south of it (z~69.5) and crosses the track team corner at x~135-140 to run inside the triangle at z~66.4; it ends at x=67. Fence posts follow the carved ground, so a post at a crossing stands in the channel
driveway culvert ends moved to z -54 / -39.5 (clear of the driveway fence post at (258.6,-52.2))
pond west tip pulled in to x~-55 so the track's inner fence (x -50..-60, z 0..5) stays on level ground; the middle-west lobe is wider to compensate
buried pipe bends: west along z=66.4 to x=59.4, then straight north
profile parameters added: ditch top width 2.7 m / bottom 0.4 m, pond bank run 9 m
_v3_changes: pond extended east to x~131 (owner: almost 130, a little farther)
ditch is mostly straight along the south fence line from the road westward
two buried sections: a culvert at the driveway, then a pipe from the track team triangle's tip (where it becomes the narrow track, x~65) north to the pond inlet at x=59.4
_v2_changes: ditch moved east: ~x=259.5 from the weir to the driveway, ~x=255 south of it (the brown band)
ditch goes underground (buried pipe/culvert) on its way to the pond
pond made larger to the west
brighter green in the imagery is dried-out pond vegetation, so the bright-green bowl and the pale NE strip are pond bed
